text: The Maharashtra government banned R. V. Bhasin's Islam: A Concept of Political World Invasion in India in 2007, on the grounds that it contained derogatory remarks about Islam that could hurt religious sentiments. Bhasin challenged the ban. In 2010, the Bombay High Court upheld it; the decision was challenged in the Supreme Court, which rejected the appeal.
